beat-the-planner.goal: Draw a path from S to G, one cell at a time. Every move costs its length, and a muddy cell costs more to enter (darker is worse). Can you match A*?
beat-the-planner.title: Beat the planner

case-file-detective.goal: A recording of the full ROS 2 stack in Gazebo. Scrub to the moment the robot's belief about where it is first leaves the truth, and mark it.
case-file-detective.title: Case File detective

map-the-arena.goal: Drive COCO to map the arena on wheel odometry alone, within a distance budget. Covering more raises the map's F1; driving further lets the drift grow.
map-the-arena.title: Map the arena

next-node.goal: A* is part-way through a search. Grey cells are closed; outlined cells are open, each with g (the cost so far) and h (the estimate to G). Click the cell A* expands next -- ten times.
next-node.title: Next node

race-the-ghost.goal: Drive COCO to the flag yourself, at the same speed limits the ghost has. The ghost is the model following A*'s path with a pure-pursuit tracker. Beat its time without hitting more than it does.
race-the-ghost.title: Race the planner's ghost

search-the-bays.goal: The target is in one of four bays, and you know only how likely each one is. Choose the order to look in. You are scored on the expected distance over where it might be -- never on where it turned out to be.

levels.story: Every bay is equally likely -- the Arena's own prior.
levels.title: No idea where it is

levels.story: Someone thinks it was taken towards bay 4.
levels.title: A hint at the far end

levels.story: It is in bay 1 or bay 4, almost certainly.
levels.title: One of the ends

levels.story: A blurry frame put it in bay 3, and the camera misses 4 times in 10.
levels.title: Seen in bay 3, by a poor camera

search-the-bays.title: Search the bays
